description: Records a Wyoming DAO LLC that already exists so it can be named as a domain's registrant. For when the user wants a domain held by their DAO LLC rather than by them personally. Scopeweb does not form LLCs and does not give legal advice: the LLC is formed with a lawyer or a registered agent first. The legal name must carry DAO, LAO or DAO LLC and an LLC designator (W.S. 17-31-104(d), 17-29-108); the registered agent must be in Wyoming. The registrar receives the LLC's legal name, its registered agent's address, a named contact person and an email this account already controls, never a wallet address. The filing number is recorded as the owner stated it, because Wyoming's filing search cannot be checked automatically. Cannot spend money and moves no domain.

agreement_url.description: Optional https link to the operating agreement.

contact.description: The person who answers for the LLC, and an email this account controls.

filing_number.description: The Wyoming Secretary of State filing id.

legal_name.description: The registered name, for example Example DAO LLC.

smart_contract.description: CAIP-10 id of the contract named in the articles (W.S. 17-31-106(b)), such as eip155:1:0x...
